title: Harness Constructors Accept Unvalidated Parameters
impact: `OwnableHarness`/`Ownable2StepHarness` accept `address(0)` as `initialOwner` (OZ's `Ownable` constructor does not zero-check in these versions), and `TimelockControllerHarness` forwards arbitrary `minDelay`/role lists. A zero owner permanently bricks `restricted()`-style admin functions; a zero default admin in `AccessControlDefaultAdminRulesHarness` bricks admin transfers.
